passages.context: The complete heading, argument, and one-paragraph letter were inspected. The confessors say Lucianus wrote the letter in the presence of two clergy, an exorcist and a reader. This is a bounded North-African institutional witness to titles present in one documentary setting, not a duty list, ordination rite, headcount, universal office, baptismal sequence, or major-exorcism procedure.
